profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Advanced technical professional bringing over 8 years of in-depth experience leading the development of mobile apps and enterprise software, covering e-commerce, networking, file transfer, live chat, and payment solutions. Dedicated to efficient, precise development, including Agile methodologies, extensive code review, library integration and creation, and performance tuning.

Software Applications • iOS Development • Web Services • Object-Oriented Programming • Machine Learning • Data Science • Agile Development • Memory Management • Database Design • Solution • Delivery • Code Review • Unit Testing • Design Patterns • RESTful APIs • Customized User Interface • Advanced Algorithms • Threading & Scheduling

Languages: Objective-C, Swift, Java
Web Services: RESTful Web Services, JSON
Frameworks: Foundation, UI Kit, Cocoapods, Fabric.io (Crashlytics), Google Analytics
Databases: Core Data, Realm, SQLite
SDLC: Kanban, Scrum/Agile, Waterfall, TDD
Tools: Xcode, Eclipse, Instrument, Git, Storyboard, Autolayout, APNs
Technologies: Threading/Concurrency, Unit Testing, Database Design
Versioning: Git, Bitbucket, Github, Source Tree
Unit Tests: XCTest, Quick.
Design Patterns: MVC, MVVM, Singleton, Decorator, Observer, Delegate, KVO, Factory, Façade
SDK: UIKit, AutoLayout, AFNetworking, Alamofire, Magical Record, FaceBook SDK, Firebase,
Google Map SDK, Cordova

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working in a project about Nursing & Feeding for baby in Mountain View, mainly responsibility for iOS application to pair with Breast Pumping device and help moms can review history and device’s conditions

Tasks & Achievements:
- Independently develop Willow Pump project and successfully publish it on AppStore
- Redesign all UI interfaces and update business logic for new version.
- Successfully deliver all the business flows in 6 months.
- Working with marketing team to design and provide technical solutions for new features.

positions.title: Senior iOS Developer
positions.description:
DXC Technology is the world’s leading independent, end-to-end IT services company, helping clients in Vietnam harness the power of innovation to thrive on change.

Responsibilities:
- Designed and implemented data management features.
- Built APIs for data processing.
- Mentored junior programmers and reviewed code.
- Administrated provisioning profiles for Ad Hoc, Enterprise, and App Store builds.
- Set up package management tools for code sharing.
- Quickly adjusted applications based on client and user feedback.
- Migrated integrated database from Core Data to Realm.
- Used Agile/Scrum methodologies to release important builds in measured sprints.

positions.title: Senior iOS Developer
positions.description:
Established in 1988, Harvey Nash has supported many of the world's leading organisations to recruit, source and manage the highly skilled talent they need to succeed in an increasingly competitive and technology driven world.

* Position : Senior iOS Engineer
* Job Descriptions :
     - Investigated and resolved critical issues in application.
     - Communicated with BA and client to adjust business features.
     - Developed and tested new features.

positions.title: Senior iOS Developer
positions.description:
- Cogini Hong Kong is a leading company in outsourcing development with clients come from the Hong Kong, Taiwan, Viet Nam and the US. Our mission is bring the best product for our customers
- Cogini has cooperated with many well-known customers as : Audi (Taiwan), Mindoula Inc, ...

* Job Description : 
- Researched and developed applications independently
- Gathered project requirements and translated into technical specifications
- Fixed bugs and scheduled milestones
- Design App Architecture
- Set up project, including system design, source, frameworks, and documents.
- Deployed every build and new version.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.locationName: Lu Gia Plaza , Lu Gia street, district 11, Ho Chi Minh City
positions.description:
- Foody was founding in early 2013 and it just took one year to reach over one million monthly unique visits. That 's quite a milestone for a company that focuses only on food-related reviews in Viet Nam
- In 2013, Foody Corp received a round of funding from CyberAgent Ventures. It shows the strong potential for content-based sites in Vietnam
- Since Foody has come to the market, user behavior has changed dramatically and Vietnamese users are becoming more and more forthcoming with writing reviews and sharing information.

* Job Description :
- Researched and developed new features on iOS app version
- Improved application's performance
- Fixed bugs and tested
- Improved UI/UX design

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.locationName: 54 Ky Con Street, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City
positions.description:
NxComm has a vision to extend our valuable knowledge and expertise on the mobile wireless embedded system to build a sustainable embedded ecosystem in Singapore, benefiting regional industries by increasing efficiency, improving human life and living condition. 
We develop embedded products and mobile applications for the market. 
In addition, we offer the following services 
•	Consultancy Service on Embedded Product Development 
•	In-Source Model on Embedded Software Development 
•	Project-based Software Development Service 
•	Reference Design Development of Embedded Products Target Customers 
•	Customers looking to add embedded wireless capability into their existing products to enhance the competitiveness 

* Job Description:
- Fixed bugs and testing
- Custom UI, render design for iOS applications
